spec.question:
We are considering enabling character iteration by default. The proposed change adds explicit default registrations for str and bytes with iterate=iter; their get behavior remains autodiscovered as before. Both the module-level registry and a newly constructed Glommer with default types enabled would receive these registrations. Glommer(register_default_types=False) and user-supplied registration overrides would retain their existing behavior. No evaluator, specifier, or error-handling code would otherwise change.

Which existing pytest tests would newly fail after exactly this change? Return a JSON list of full pytest node IDs, sorted lexicographically.
